simulator_requirement: Isaac Sim only; native CameraCore pre-ISP CFA; MuJoCo path rejected by user
status: 已找到官方通用采集/扩增/回放脚本；未找到当前 DROID 九组任务的现成自动专家生成器
reason: PolaRiS 公开仿真共同训练 RLDS 缺少逐帧物体状态。Isaac Lab 的状态记录和回放工具可复用，但当前 DROID 没有 Mimic 入口，默认 SE3 遥操作与 8 维绝对关节动作未接通；仍需选定专家来源并适配。
verification_scope: pinned source inspection and cloud file SHA256 verification; these collection/generation/replay scripts were not GPU-tested on the current DROID task

record_demos.assessment: Manual expert teleoperation to HDF5; generic action/state recorder retains initial and post-step articulation/rigid object state. Default keyboard/SpaceMouse SE3 commands need a DROID jointpos adapter.

replay_demos.assessment: Restores initial state and replays saved actions; --validate_states compares saved post-step states with replay states. It is not per-frame forced state restoration and has no native RAW writer.

mimic_generate_dataset.assessment: Augments annotated seed demonstrations; requires a compatible Mimic environment. Current DROID base sets mimic_env=None and derived jointpos embodiments do not provide an implementation.

lift_cube_state_machine.assessment: Franka cube lift example; different embodiment, gripper and task; not a complete DROID nine-variation pick-and-place expert.

state_recorders.assessment: InitialStateRecorder and PostStepStatesRecorder use scene.get_state(is_relative=True), covering registered articulated and rigid assets. Camera, lighting, asset versions and RAW provenance require additional metadata.

recorder_config.assessment: Records initial state, post-step state, pre-step action/observation and processed action. Pre-action image i aligns with initial state at i=0 and post-step state i-1 for later frames.

droid.assessment: Pinned DROID class assigns self.mimic_env=None. The selected droid_abs_joint_pos embodiment has 7 joint position plus 1 gripper commands.

arena_env_builder.assessment: Mimic entry point is selected from embodiment.get_mimic_env(); generic task support cannot replace the missing embodiment implementation.

replay_tolerance_note: generic replay compares articulation/rigid-object components using absolute difference; must define stricter per-field units and camera/RAW checks for this dataset
other_official_datasets: GR1/G1 Mimic demonstration datasets exist but are different tasks/embodiments; not substituted for DROID
curobo_note: Arena cuRobo extension is used for environment reachability checks; no complete expert pick-and-place generator for these nine configurations was verified
candidate_next_steps: adapt DROID teleoperation/IK and record a few verified successful seed demonstrations, then implement DROID Mimic integration
implement and verify a DROID-specific scripted/planning expert; would create a new dataset, not recover the checkpoint original training trajectories
